The Mocs, led by third-year head coach [[Lamont Paris]], played their home games at [[McKenzie Arena]] in [[Chattanooga, Tennessee]], as members of the [[Southern Conference]] (SoCon). They finished the season 20–13, 10–8 in SoCon play, to finish in a tie for fifth place. They defeated [[2019–20 UNC Greensboro Spartans men's basketball team|UNC Greensboro]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2020 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2019–20 Wofford Terriers men's basketball team|Wofford]]. ==Previous season== The [[2018–19 Chattanooga Mocs men's basketball team|Mocs]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 12–20 overall, 7–11 in SoCon play, to finish in fifth place. In the [[2019 Southern Conference men's basketball tournament|SoCon tournament]], they were defeated by [[2018–19 East Tennessee State Buccaneers men's basketball team|East Tennessee State]] in the
